concerns.text: The plan cites a VAERS parquet file at `https://huggingface.co/datasets/chrisvoncsefalvay/vaers-outcomes/resolve/main/data/test-00000-of-00001.parquet`. This appears to be a test subset rather than the full 2020‑2023 VAERS dataset required by the research specification. Using a limited test file may omit many COVID‑19 reports and thus be inappropriate for the intended statistical analysis. The plan should reference and download the complete VAERS dataset covering the 2020‑2023 period (or explicitly justify that the test subset is sufficient for the analysis).
